decisions.reason: The fouling detection automation was launched only in 2023 and builds on the firm's existing automation offer, so it costs little to keep while its value in energy-recovery applications is still uncertain.

A web tool for weir dimensioning is cheap to maintain, supports the firm's core flood-control and water business by generating leads with engineering planners, and its results are not yet known, so the option is worth keeping open.
The fouling detection system overlaps with Product A and could later be merged with it, but after only one year on the market there is too little evidence to abandon it, and keeping it costs little.
